data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. The Google reviews are detailed, specific, and span multiple years with different customer experiences. The lower Yelp rating is based on a very small sample (7 reviews) and does not contradict the positive narrative; it may reflect platform bias. No patterns of complaints or red flags like ghosting or deposits are present. The BBB A+ rating with no complaints is a positive signal.
authentic_signals: Specific project details and crew names (Brandon, Tony, Jack, Dustin, Travis)
Mentions of realistic timelines and challenges (pandemic, rain)
Mix of review dates over several years
data.discrepancy_explanation: Moderate discrepancy between Google (4.3/34 reviews) and Yelp (3.4/7 reviews). This is not extreme and could be due to platform differences (Yelp often has fewer, more critical reviews) or sample size.

reviews.text: Sun-Ray Pools designed and constructed the beautiful backyard oasis we've always wanted. Brandon, Tony and Jack were extremely friendly, courteous, and very professional. We reached out and got quotes from about 20 different pool companies, and Sun-Ray had one of the best prices for a company with such high reviews. They are amazing builders, and you’d be a fool not to go with them. The actual construction of the pool was only 3 months which is extremely fast given the fact that we’re in the middle of a pandemic, and we also got a month of rain in that time frame. Brandon was in constant communication during the entire process, which really made us feel like they truly value their customers. The final result was well worth every penny! Thanks for everything!
reviews.author: nathan struzick

reviews.text: Tony and his team built our pool almost a year ago! It’s been the best investment for our family! Travis responds within the same working day and sometimes on the weekend. I can send texts, video, or just call and he’s always willing to help me even if my questions or concerns are silly (first time pool owner here)! We refer them to anyone who will listen!
reviews.author: Amber Gill

reviews.text: Sun ray has been A pleasure to deal with. This is our first pool and we probably asked some stupid questions, but Brandon never made us feel that way. We is responsive and met every deadline, even during a time when pool equipment was scarce. I have recommended Sun Ray Pools to my mother for her new build. Look no further for a pool builder!
reviews.author: brian fox

reviews.text:
We decided to go with Sun-Ray Pools after numerous co-workers used the company. From start to finish, we had nothing but a positive experience. Dustin was extremely responsive to my questions (I had many), and he was willing to sit down and work with us when he knew we were going to take a bit to commit to putting the pool in. The cost of the build was similar to other quotes we received and in line with the market. (This is to be expected, as most companies use the same sub contractors).

One aspect we really enjoyed about Sun-Ray was the person you initially meet is the person in charge of your building your pool - Dustin designed our pool (old school graphing paper) and then managed the crew - this is rare for pool companies, as you usually deal with a salesperson at first.

If you are looking for a pool in the DFW area, I highly recommend Sun-Ray Pools and Dustin.
reviews.author: Kyle

reviews.text: I’ve been involved with every aspect of substantial construction projects for over 35 years, and I am very happy to say that I have NEVER seen ANY project run as efficiently as the recent construction of our swimming pool. Greg (our project foreman) came highly recommended, and from the first time that I met him, I had no doubt that our hopes and expectations would be met. I never had to ask him anything twice, and he answered most of my questions before I had a chance to ask them. As mentioned in other reviews, the entire process was flawless, and the experience was awesome. Greg hit this one out of the park!
reviews.author: Barry Hance

reviews.text: Smooth, easy building process. Sun-Ray gave me a great pool within my budget.
reviews.author: Amey

reviews.text: We met with multiple pool companies and received several quotes before deciding on Sun-Ray. Dustin did a great job of listening to what we wanted and bringing it to fruition. He has been very responsive to our calls and texts. They also finished our pool in less than 4 weeks! As a side note, I highly recommend adding the abalone shell if you do the pebble finish...it looks amazing!
reviews.author: Stacy Rogers

reviews.text: SunRay built our pool over a year ago and delivered a beautiful pool in the promised time frame. Since then, they have been prompt with following up on any warranty issues. Jack, our project manager, is a great communicator and has always helped us with any questions or concerns. In fact, everyone we have encountered has been an amazing human. I love SunRay and am so glad we chose them!
reviews.author: Sara Wright
